caveats: New PID initial ticks need process birth/starttime and aligned sampling before subtracting them as exact interval work
Disappearing processes can lose final ticks
Host CPU snapshot is collected after sequential process samples
Watchdog/coordinator CPU is not external user workload but is omitted from inner own attribution
Linux /proc/io rchar/syscr are file-I/O counters; do not infer socket byte/syscall counts from them
future_method: Track (PID,starttime), observer and all registered groups; persist final waited CPU or bounded exit attribution; timestamp/bracket samples and report uncertainty. Keep 10percent threshold; formally review metric changes.
